title: Israel and Iran, June 2025: a country note priced per fact
customer: An oil and shipping risk desk (Brent, tanker rates through the Strait of Hormuz, war-risk premiums) that must separate what happened from what was threatened before it moves a position.
note: Claims written the way a desk analyst would put them in a note. Observations are checked through Telegraph; forecasts are listed and not bought. c6 is the failure case on purpose: Iran's parliament backed closing the Strait of Hormuz, but the strait was not closed, so a note that says it was is wrong in the way that costs money.
